title: Shadow Monitoring: Emergent Model Capability Drift & Procurement Impact Analysis
creator: Asha Mehta
description:
Goal: build a practical monitoring and triage playbook that detects emergent capability/behavioral drift in third-party models used by our customers and quantifies procurement and latency/cost implications. Scope: midmarket RAG + multi-turn chat workloads that are sensitive to hallucination, embedding quality, and small-context retrieval latency. Out of scope: full enterprise procurement negotiations (we will surface signals for Sales/Procurement to action).

Why now: multiple field reports and telemetry spikes indicated transient degradations from upstream model provider changes. We need an automated way to (1) detect drift in capability that affects product features, (2) rapidly estimate switching cost (latency/cost/quality) for fallback models, and (3) create a lightweight procurement alert for Sales/SRE.

Primary deliverables: 1) Drift detector dashboard (delta in key metrics + sample prompts) 2) Switching-cost quick-assessor (latency/cost/quality delta estimator) 3) Internal playbook with runbook steps and template messages for customers and Sales 4) Pilot alerting integration with Model Watchtower and Slack triage channel.
objectives: Define 6-8 behavioral metrics (hallucination rate, answer divergence, embed recall loss, token cost delta, p99 latency delta, semantic drift score)
Instrument telemetry and create dashboard with annotated sample prompts showing degradation windows
Produce one-page switching-cost estimator that combines token-price, observed latency, and rerank/embeddings quality changes
Run 2 field probes with midmarket customers (sales-sourced) to validate signal usefulness and refine alert thresholds

acceptance_criteria: Drift dashboard displays metric deltas and at least 5 sampled prompts per detected window
Switch-cost estimator gives a concise numerical estimate that a Sales rep can use within 10 minutes of an incident
Playbook contains 3 clear escalation tiers and message templates for low/medium/high impact
Pilot customers confirm alerts were actionable in at least 1 of 2 field probes

Risk: Switching cost estimator is an approximation; assumption: Sales will use estimates as advisory not contractual
Risk: False positives from natural model variance; mitigation: require sustained delta for 30 minutes before high-severity alert
